+                       if ((!xmlStrcasecmp(attr->name, BAD_CAST"http-equiv"))

+                           http = 1;
+                       else if ((value != NULL)
+                        && (!xmlStrcasecmp(attr->name, BAD_CAST"content")))
+                           content = value;
+                       if ((http != 0) && (content != NULL))
+                           goto found_content;

+               }
